name: H3 Reference to Video
summary: The complete MiniMax H3 reference pipeline: nine pictures, three clips with their own sound and three audio clips, optional, in one shot with its soundtrack.

source.notes: Converted with tools/import_workflow.py, then rebuilt around the node's autogrow slots: nine ref_images, three ref_videos with their paired ref_video_audios (from GetVideoComponents), three ref_audios. Every slot is optional; the runner cuts the edge and prunes the loader when a slot is empty (input.unlink + runner.pruneGraph), so an unused slot never runs a LoadImage on a placeholder. Steps, sampler and the turbo LoRA keep the workflow's own switches.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: A street cook in Mexico City flips tacos on a hot griddle, steam and sizzling sound. He looks up and says: "Two more coming right up!" The camera pushes in slowly.
inputs.help: Reference the slots by name: <Picture 1>, <Video 1>, <Audio 1>. Spoken words go in quotes.

inputs.label: Resolution (MP)
inputs.help: Total pixels of the clip, sides rounded to 32. 0.4 MP is 832x480 at 16:9; higher is sharper and much slower.

inputs.label: Seconds
inputs.help: Up to 15. The frame count is the workflow's own formula: 24 fps, rounded up to a multiple of 17.

inputs.label: Sampler
inputs.help: euler is the workflow's default and what the turbo LoRA expects; res_multistep is smoother at 20 steps.

inputs.label: Turbo (4-step LoRA)
inputs.help: On: the ref2v turbo LoRA is patched in and the sampler runs the fast branch. Set Steps to about 4.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: 4 with Turbo on, 20 with it off. Written to both branches of the workflow's own switch.

inputs.label: Sparse attention (SLA)
inputs.help: ON: nœud d'attention creuse H3 (kernel Triton maison, validé jusqu'à ~53k tokens seulement) — rapide. OFF (défaut): attention dense, plus lente mais sans kernel custom — à garder tant que les rendus longs font tomber le GPU (ring timeout).

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: -1 picks a random seed.

notes: Reference to video: the model keeps the people, places and voices you give it. Nine pictures, three videos and three audio clips can be mixed freely, all optional; the prompt refers to them as <Picture 1>, <Video 1>, <Audio 1>. A reference video brings its own frames and its own soundtrack, so give it a clip with sound. Turbo patches the workflow's own 4-step LoRA in place of the full model branch; set Steps to 4 with it, 20 without. Resolution is the template's ResolutionSelector (aspect + megapixels), and the frame count comes from Seconds through the workflow's own formula. The LoRA is a local file, not in the video-h3 pack.
